title: Electrical Maintenance Engineer
description:
Company

Competitive Salary - Company Vehicle - Day Shift

Nigel Wright is pleased to exclusively support a market-leading business in Teesside as they make significant investments in their engineering department.

We are seeking an experienced engineer to join a dynamic team. This is a day shift position offering a competitive salary up to £48,000 basic, along with frequent overtime opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package with regular pay reviews.

The business is keen to train and develop all engineers, with a collaborative and supportive work environment, whilst offering opportunities for career progression.

If you want to maximise your potential earnings whilst developing your career, this is an excellent opportunity.

Role

Multi Skilled Engineer –
  • Conduct electrical fault finding on a variety of machines and equipment.
  • Work confidently with and without engineering drawings.
  • Meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Previous experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with three-phase systems.
  • Experience with inverters, drives, motors, and gearboxes.

Person

The business is offering –
  • A strong focus on continuous improvement and upskilling the workforce.
  • Commitment to advanced training and learning new skills.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment, whilst having autonomy and responsibility for your own work.
  • Opportunities for career advancement.

If you are passionate about maintenance, take pride in your work, and are eager to develop your skills, this is a great role for you!

Competitive earning potential - OTE of £60,000+
